standard_prerequisites.name: Two source fibres of a groupoid over a field become isomorphic over a common field extension, transporting a prescribed pair of points (more-groupoids chapter, Lemma lemma-two-fibres, no canonical tag in the snapshot; no-tag pointer to the source label line, parts (1) and (2))
standard_prerequisites.use: Its parts (1) and (2) give verbatim the field extension, the isomorphism phi with phi(r_1) = r_2, and the projections pr_0(r_1) = r, pr_0(r_2) = r'.

core_obligations: Specialization step: apply the two-fibres lemma, parts (1) and (2), to the points r and r' of R (U being Spec(k) for a field k). Those parts provide a field extension k'/k, points r_1, r_2 of R x_{s, Spec(k)} Spec(k'), and a diagram R, R x_{s, Spec(k)} Spec(k') with pr_0 both ways and an isomorphism phi in the middle, such that phi is an isomorphism of schemes over Spec(k'), phi(r_1) = r_2, pr_0(r_1) = r, and pr_0(r_2) = r'. Conclusion: exactly the assertion of the lemma, with no additional work.
proof_roadmap: Instantiate parts (1) and (2) of lemma-two-fibres at the pair r, r' and read off the extension, the isomorphism and the two projections (proof lines 1213-1215).
